neighbours.label: A modifier naming a vessel system before its noun (blood vessels, lymph nodes, vascular channels), vs the same words as plain substances
fire: High blood pressure slowly damages the walls of small blood vessels.
The surgeon removed several swollen lymph nodes from her neck.
The scan showed new vascular growth around the tumour.
Smoking narrows the blood vessels that supply the legs.
The infection spread through the lymph vessels to the armpit.
Doctors suspected a vascular malformation in the brain.
Tiny blood vessels in the eye can burst during a coughing fit.
Biopsies of the lymph nodes confirmed that the cancer had spread.
quiet: High winds slowly damage the walls of small wooden sheds.
The surgeon removed several stitches from her neck.
The scan showed nothing unusual around the knee.
Smoking stains the fingers and teeth of heavy users.
The infection spread to her friends at the school.
Doctors suspected a sprain in the wrist.
Tiny boats in the harbour can capsize during a storm.
Biopsies are sent to the laboratory every afternoon.
